title: Cryptocurrency Price Forecasting Using Machine Learning: Building Intelligent Financial Prediction Models
venue_or_source: International Journal of Accounting and Economics Studies, 12 (3) (2025) 255-268
label_definition: forecast the closing price of the XRP/USDT trading pair
data_requirements: Historical XRP/USDT time series covering daily closing prices from 2018 to 2022.
Daily trading volume for XRP from 2018 to 2022.
Liquidity proxy features computed from the data: Volume-To-Volatility Ratio (VVR) and Volume-Weighted Average Price (VWAP).
Chronological split into approximately 70% training, 15% validation, and 15% testing with no random shuffling.
training_protocol: Train an LSTM model on chronologically ordered XRP/USDT data with liquidity features VVR and VWAP included. Use approximately 70% of observations for training and 15% for validation; preserve temporal order with no random shuffling. The paper reports LSTM training and validation loss curves over 25 epochs and mentions early stopping/validation monitoring, but does not report exact input window length, batch size, optimizer, random seed, or early-stopping patience.
evaluation_protocol: Evaluate once on the final chronologically held-out 15% test set reserved for unseen data. Metrics are calculated on this separate test set; the paper does not describe walk-forward evaluation or context overlap.
strict_requirements: Use XRP/USDT as the target trading pair.

Do not randomly shuffle the time series.
Use approximately 70% training, 15% validation, and 15% testing.
